domain-information: A Mall Manager plans the overall layout of the mall and assigns spaces to different shops to optimize foot traffic
A Mall Manager reviews tenant requests and approves changes to shop layouts to improve customer experience
A Shop Owner selects merchandise and arranges displays to attract visitors and increase sales
A Shop Owner updates inventory and sales records to coordinate with mall promotions
A Security Officer monitors the mall and conducts patrols to ensure visitor safety and prevent theft
A Security Officer coordinates with shop owners and mall management to respond to incidents or emergencies
A Customer visits multiple shops and provides feedback on store layouts and shopping experience

domain objects.name: Mall Manager
domain objects.description: person responsible for planning layouts and managing mall operations

domain objects.name: Mall Layout
domain objects.description: overall arrangement of mall areas and shop placements

domain objects.name: Mall Space
domain objects.description: physical unit within the mall assigned to a shop

domain objects.name: Tenant Request
domain objects.description: request submitted by a shop owner for changes or support

domain objects.name: Shop Owner
domain objects.description: person managing a shop and its operations

domain objects.name: Display
domain objects.description: visual arrangement of merchandise to attract customers

domain objects.name: Inventory
domain objects.description: record of goods available in a shop

domain objects.name: Sales Records
domain objects.description: logs of transactions and revenue for a shop

domain objects.name: Security Officer
domain objects.description: person responsible for maintaining safety in the mall

domain objects.name: Patrol
domain objects.description: security check performed across mall spaces

domain objects.name: Emergency Response
domain objects.description: action taken to handle incidents or emergencies

domain objects.name: Customer
domain objects.description: visitor who shops and interacts with mall services

domain objects.name: Feedback
domain objects.description: customer input on mall or shop experience

associations.description: Mall Manager creates and updates Mall Layout
Mall Layout defines organization of each Mall Space
Mall Manager assigns and manages each Mall Space
Mall Manager reviews and decides on each Tenant Request
Mall Manager coordinates overall Emergency Response
Feedback is provided to Mall Manager for improvements
Shop Owner submits Tenant Request to management
Shop Owner operates and manages the Shop
Shop Owner updates and uses Sales Records
Shop Owner maintains the shop’s Inventory
Shop Owner arranges Display in the shop
Shop Owner may initiate Emergency Response when needed
Security Officer executes Emergency Response actions
Patrol covers and checks each Mall Space
Customer visits and interacts with the Shop
Customer provides Feedback on mall or shop experience
